tagline: Guided Docker and Compose app installation for ZimaOS
description:
Self-hosted installation assistant for Docker images, GitHub projects and
Compose applications on ZimaOS. Includes four app catalogs, multi-container
configuration, resource and GPU options, and five interface languages.
Beta 18 recognizes pasted Docker service definitions without the top-level
services block and safely builds a valid Compose structure before analysis.
Beta 17 NAS mount automation, verified publisher stacks and safe shell
command handling remain available. Unclear media sources are never invented.
First launch defaults to English; any previously saved language remains selected.
The ZimaOS administration LAN address is saved for future installations. When an authenticator is configured or a reverse proxy host is allowed, each installation requires an authenticator code. GitHub/Codeberg source builds verify an immutable commit.

**IMPORTANT — Before installation:** Choose Custom install → Advanced and
replace IM_ADMIN_USERNAME, IM_ADMIN_PASSWORD (at least 12 characters),
and IM_SESSION_SECRET (a unique random secret, at least 32 characters).
The app deliberately refuses to start with CHANGE_ME placeholders.

Access the web interface on port 9012 only via a trusted LAN, VPN or
secured HTTPS reverse proxy. Docker socket access provides extensive
permissions on the NAS. Port 50813 is reserved for a localhost-only
registry. Existing Install Monitor deployments must not be overwritten.
This is a beta; a clean ZimaOS store installation is not yet verified.

tips.before_install: Advanced custom installation is REQUIRED. Replace IM_ADMIN_USERNAME, IM_ADMIN_PASSWORD (12+ characters) and IM_SESSION_SECRET (32+ random characters). Do not install with CHANGE_ME placeholders. Keep port 9012 off the public Internet. Do not reinstall over an existing deployment.
